# Web Piano Teacher

> > Online piano instruction platform offering video lessons taught by Shawn Cheek, specializing in popular music, classical repertoire, and ear training techniques.

Web Piano Teacher (WPT) is a membership-based online learning platform founded by piano instructor Shawn Cheek in Waco, Texas. The site features an extensive song library covering artists like Billy Joel, Barry Manilow, Bruce Springsteen, The Beatles, and classical composers including Beethoven and Chopin, with lessons organized by artist, genre, and skill level.
